titles.native: ポケットモンスター ダイヤモンド・パール 特別編

description:
Two special episodes during the airing of Pokemon Best Wishes! featuring the old characters from the Diamond & Pearl series Hikari and Takeshi with their Pokemon.

Episode 1: Hikari - Setting off on a New Journey! (ヒカリ・新たなる旅立ち!)

Episode 2: Nibi Gym - The Greatest Crisis Ever! (ニビジム・史上最大の危機!)
